assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not contain any questions asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while doing other activities. Care activities appear only as response options for why a person worked fewer hours (h16 option 5), why a person did not seek work (j7 option 3), or why a person left their previous job (j24 option 2). As specified by the indicator rules, care mentioned as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count. Therefore, supervisory or secondary care work is not mentioned in the questionnaire.
